Subject: Invoice submission options for UK vendors — portal vs email + VAT line requirements

Hi Samir / Acme team,

Thanks for onboarding with Redwood Inference — welcome aboard. Before we enable your supplier profile in our AP system I want to confirm the most reliable way for Acme to submit invoices so we can ensure timely PO matching and payment.

A few details we need from you and a couple of preferences from our side:
- Preferred intake method: do you have SFTP or portal export capability? Our portal (preferred) allows automatic PO stamping and 3-way matching. Email submission is acceptable as a fallback but requires a strict template.
- Required invoice fields for UK VAT: invoice number, invoice date, PO number (exact match), gross amount, VAT amount, VAT registration number, and a per-line description + unit price.
- File formats: PDF for official invoices; CSV for bulk invoices is supported if lines map to our template (I attached our onboarding form).
- Bank details & remittance: please include bank sort code/IBAN and payment instructions on the invoice. If you require us to add a standing payment instruction, state that explicitly.

Can you confirm:
1) Which intake method you prefer (portal / SFTP / email) and whether you can add PO numbers to each invoice PDF as an editable field that our AP system can read.
2) Whether you can produce a one-line and a per-line CSV export matching the attached sample (vendor-onboarding-form.pdf).
3) Typical invoice cadence (weekly / monthly / per-job) and approximate invoice volume.

If email is your only option, please send invoices to invoices@redwood.com with the subject line: Redwood PO <PO_NUMBER> — Acme Invoice <INVOICE_NUMBER> to ensure routing.

Thanks — if you prefer a quick 15-min call to walk through the portal we can set that up this week.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0133

Hi Avery,

Thanks — Samir here. We can support two intake methods immediately:
1) Portal upload (SFTP-backed) — we can push a nightly CSV export that includes PO number mapping and per-line VAT breakdowns.
2) Email PDF — we can send individual PDFs to invoices@redwood.com.

A few notes on our side:
- Our invoices currently include VAT as a single line; we can output per-line VAT amounts if you need them, but it will be a small config change (we can do this by end of next week).
- Bank details are included on all invoices. For UK payments we provide sort code + account number and IBAN.
- Typical cadence: weekly consolidated invoices (usually 1–3 invoices/week), sometimes monthly for subscription items.

Attached is a redline of a sample PDF we typically send (acme_invoice_sample.pdf).

If portal is preferred for PO stamping and matching, please share the endpoint/credentials and the CSV column mapping we should follow. Otherwise we'll send PDFs with the subject line you suggested.

Best,
Samir Patel
Finance Operations 
Acme Data Solutions

On 2025-07-12 09:03, Acme Data Solutions wrote:
> Hi Avery,
>
> Thanks — Samir here. We can support two intake methods immediately:
> 1) Portal upload (SFTP-backed) — we can push a nightly CSV export that includes PO number mapping and per-line VAT breakdowns.
> 2) Email PDF — we can send individual PDFs to invoices@redwood.com.

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Redwood preferences and a few operational rules so AP can match and pay promptly: 
- Preferred: portal (SFTP or direct portal). If using CSV, columns must include: invoice_id, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), supplier_vat_number, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, line_net, line_vat, line_gross, currency. Use UTF-8 and include a header row.
- Fallback: PDF emailed to invoices@redwood.com with filename format Redwood_PO<PO_NUMBER>_ACME_<INVOICE_NUMBER>.pdf and email subject like: Redwood PO <PO_NUMBER> — Acme Invoice <INVOICE_NUMBER>. This triggers the AP mailbox parser.
- VAT: For UK suppliers include supplier VAT number and VAT per line; if you cannot provide per-line VAT immediately we can accept a single VAT line temporarily but please flag invoices that are 'single-line VAT' so they go to manual review.
- PO stamping & matching: we require the PO number on the invoice body (not just the filename). For consolidated invoices that cover multiple POs, include a CSV attachment with PO-level breakdown or ensure each PO is listed with amounts.

I attached the current vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (standard form and the CSV example). Samir, if you can provide a one-week trial CSV (tonight's nightly export or a sample) we will validate mapping in our staging parser and confirm acceptance.

I'll coordinate with AP to whitelist acme's SFTP host if we go that route. Ben / Laura — can you confirm we have a temporary routing rule to accept single-VAT invoices into manual review?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference

2) If CSV matches, Redwood will whitelist SFTP host and enable automatic PO stamping. Expect confirmation from Ben within 48 hours.

I'll schedule a short 15-min session for Friday to walk through the portal upload process — calendar invite to follow.
